_about: Public-domain François Fénelon (1651-1715, Archbishop of Cambrai) in English for the Word Hoard: The Existence of God in the anonymous translation of 1713, ed. Henry Morley (1888), from Project Gutenberg, and from Internet Archive scans the Spiritual Letters to Men and to Women (1877), Richard Haughton's Spiritual Works (1822, two volumes), Pious Reflections (1796) and The Maxims of the Saints (1698). His Telemachus is fiction and his Education of Daughters is on another lane's shelf. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
